name: Recursive Teaching Dimension / Antichain Number
details: For every finite binary concept class, recursive teaching dimension dominates the antichain number.
proof: Let $T$ be a recursive teacher map of width $d$. At every recursive layer, pad each target-consistent teaching sample to size exactly $d$; it remains a teaching sample in that layer. Samples assigned to two distinct targets are unequal: the target removed earlier is taught against every target removed later, and two targets removed together are taught against one another. Thus the padded samples form an inclusion-antichain, proving $\mathrm{AN}\le\mathrm{RTD}$.
witness_verification: For quadratic-residue tournament classes, $\mathrm{AN}=1$ while $\mathrm{RTD}=\Omega(\log p)$ by the established value records, so the gap is unbounded.
